title: Course portal: sessions.json
description: One course's sessions for one year. Lives in content/<active|archive>/<year>/<course>/, next to the session folders. The order here is the order on the course page.

label.description: Only when this course's year should show a different name than the year id.

programme.description: Only when it differs from the course's programme in courses.json.

note.description: One line about this course's offering this year.

id.description: Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens, unique in this file. Used in links (slides.html#<course>/<year>/<id>), so do not change it once shared.

label.description: Use instead of type and number for an unnumbered item.

folder.description: The session's folder, next to this file, e.g. module-3-inflation-unemployment.

file.description: Only when the slides are not slides.md inside the folder.

updated.description: Set automatically to the day you commit a change to this session's folder (git hook, see README). You can also type it.

visibility.description: public: listed and opens. unlisted: opens from a link but is not listed. hidden: not listed and does not open.
